Infantry Barracks — 16 Infantry Heroes, Pair Calculator & T1–T6 Unit Tiers.

Trains frontline high-DEF/HP Shield & Shotgun Infantry squads. Infantry units counter fast Rider marches and absorb heavy damage in Rallies and Shelter Garrisons.
